chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Mansur, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the Bedouins: Is jihad upon them? He said: No, except if there is a fear for Islam, so they are sought for assistance. I said: So do they have anything from the jizyah? He said: No.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, referring to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.الْأَعْرَابِ: The Bedouins, specifically referring to Arabs in the post-Prophetic era
key_terms.الْجِزْيَةِ: Jizyah, a tax levied on non-Muslim subjects
key_terms.جِهَادٌ: Striving or fighting in the path of God

ai.seo_question: Are Arab Bedouins obligated to perform jihad and pay jizyah according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi delineates the specific legal status of the A'rab (Arab Bedouins) in the post-Prophetic era, distinguishing their military obligation from that of settled Muslims by limiting jihad to times of necessity for the defense of Islam. It further establishes their exemption from jizyah, reflecting the scholarly view that their unique social structure and proximity to the faith warranted a distinct fiscal and military treatment compared to the general populace.

en.hubeali:
Muhamad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Mansour, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the Bedouins, it there Jihaad upon them?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, except if there is a fear upon Al-Islam, so assistance would be sought by them’. I said, ‘So would there by anything from the taxation for them?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Mansur from Hisham ibn Salim who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, Ts it obligatory for the Arabs to do Jihad?’

He (the Imam) replied, ’No, Jihad is not obligatory on them unless al-Islam is feared for.’ I then asked, ’Do they have any share in al-Jizyah (taxes)?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘No, they do not have any share therein.’”
